name: Sawaguchi Chikako
source:
"I thought I warned you—learn to judge women better."

Koichi’s ex-girlfriend, though they still remain on friendly terms.
She currently works as Professor Motoyama’s assistant and is part of the same seminar.
Though she often speaks in a cool and detached manner, she isn’t truly cold-hearted.
Even in summer, she habitually wears black leather gloves.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
